raw_segments.text: Hermione, what have I twice said well? When wasp before, I prithee tell me. Crams with
praise and makes us fat as tame things. One good deed dying tongueless slaughters a thousand
waiting upon that. Our praises are our wages. You may rides with one soft kiss a thousand
furlongs ere with spur we heed an acre. But to T.H. goal, my last good deed was to entreat
his stay. What was my first? It has an elder sister or I mistake you. Oh, would her name
were Grace. But once before I spoke to the purpose, when, nay, let me haved, I long.
